content: प्रस्रवः .²1 Trickling forth, gushing, flowing or oozing out. .²2 A flow, stream. .²3 Milk flowing from the breast or udder; प्रस्रवे च शुचिर्वत्सः <ls>Ms. 5. 130</ls>; प्रस्रवेण (<ab>v. l.</ab> for प्रस्नवेन) अभिवर्षन्ती वत्सालोकप्रवर्तिना <ls>R. 1. 84</ls>. .²4 Urine. .²5 The overflowing scum of boiling rice. .{@-वाः@} (<ab>pl.</ab>) .²1 Falling or gushing tears. .²2 morbid matter in the body. .{@-वम्@} A waterfall.
